ACTIVATE.
Feel the squeeze. Last set to failure.

LOAD.
Explosive concentric. Leave 1 rep in tank.

PUMP.
Last set: drop set to failure.

STRETCH.
3-sec eccentric. Deep stretch at bottom. Last set: partials + 10-sec iso-hold in stretched position.
Full stretch at bottom, 2-sec hold. Last set: drop set.
Kneel facing cable. Rope behind head. Crunch DOWN, not forward — think ribs to pelvis. Exhale hard at bottom. Do NOT pull with arms.
Dead hang. Raise legs with control — no swinging. Curl pelvis up at top to engage lower abs. Slow eccentric.

ACTIVATE.
Constant tension, lean forward. Feel lats engage. Last set to failure.

LOAD.
Explosive pull, controlled eccentric. Leave 1 rep in tank.

PUMP.
Last set: drop set to failure.

STRETCH.
Perpendicular across bench, deep stretch. Last set: partials in stretched position + 10-sec iso-hold at bottom.
Wide grip angle for upper back width.
Pinkies high, squeeze at peak.
External rotation at top.

ACTIVATE.
Set incline 15-20 degs.
Constant tension. Focus on FEELING the pec stretch at bottom and squeeze at top. Controlled tempo. NOT heavy — it’s about waking up the chest. Last set to failure.

LOAD.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width. Bar path: lower to upper chest/clavicle line. Explosive press, 2-sec eccentric. Shoulder blades pinched and DOWN. 
Leave 1 rep in tank.

PUMP.
Seat height so handles align with upper chest. Full ROM — deep stretch at bottom, do NOT lock out at top. Constant tension. Last set: drop set (strip 30%, rep to failure).

STRETCH.
MID for flat pec stretch or LOW for upper pec. Step forward for full stretch at bottom. Last set: 4-5 partial reps in stretched position + 10-sec iso-hold at full stretch with pecs loaded.
Slight forward lean from hips (10-15 degrees). Lead with elbows, not hands. Raise to just above shoulder height. Do NOT shrug traps. Control the negative — no swinging.
Stand sideways to cable. Start with cable BEHIND your body for full ROM. Constant tension throughout — cable never goes slack. This is why cable laterals hit harder than DBs at the bottom of the move
UPRIGHT torso for tricep emphasis (leaning forward shifts to chest). Full lockout at top. Control the descent. Add weight via belt.
Rope attachment, face away from cable. Lean forward slightly. Get a DEEP stretch on the long head at the bottom of each rep. Full extension at top. Squeeze tricep 1 sec.

ACTIVATION.
Full contraction — curl all the way in, squeeze hamstrings 1-2 sec at peak. Controlled eccentric. Last set to failure.

LOAD.
Feet hip width, slight knee bend. Push hips BACK, bar stays close to legs. Feel deep hamstring stretch. Stop when you feel max stretch; don’t round lower back. 1 RIR
PUMP: Drive through heels. Full lockout at top — squeeze glutes HARD for 1 sec. Do not hyperextend lower back. Last set: drop set (strip 30%, rep to failure).

STRETCH.
Long stride for deep stretch on rear leg hip flexor and front leg hamstring/glute. 3-sec eccentric on every rep. Last set: 4-5 partial reps at bottom + 10-sec iso-hold in deepest position.
Additional hamstring volume. Lighter than activation sets. Focus on peak contraction squeeze.
Slow 3-sec eccentric, FULL stretch at bottom (hold 1 sec), explosive rise. Last set: drop set.
Kneel facing cable. Rope behind head. Crunch DOWN, not forward — think ribs to pelvis. Exhale hard at bottom. Do NOT pull with arms.
Dead hang. Raise legs with control — no swinging. Curl pelvis up at top to engage lower abs. Slow eccentric.

ACTIVATION.
Behind-body cable start for full ROM. This hits the medial delt in the lengthened position. Strict form, no body english. Feel the burn. Last set to failure.

LOAD.
Bench at 80-85 degrees. DBs start at shoulder height. Explosive press, do NOT lock out at top; keep tension on delts). 2-sec eccentric. Leave 1 RIR.

PUMP.
If using DBs, slight forward lean. Last set: REST-PAUSE (rep to failure, rest 20 sec, rep to failure, rest 20 sec, rep to failure). Total reps across the rest-pause should be 15-20.

STRETCH.
Reverse pec deck or cable. Emphasis on the STRETCH across the back at the start of each rep. Squeeze at peak 1 sec. Last set: 4-5 partial reps in stretched position + 10-sec iso-hold.
WIDE grip (hands outside shoulders). Elbows lead, pull to chin height. Wide grip reduces shoulder impingement risk vs narrow grip. Hits lateral and anterior delts + traps.
Full extension at bottom, SPREAD rope apart at bottom for peak contraction on lateral head. Elbows pinned to sides throughout. No leaning into the weight.
Single DB held overhead with both hands. Lower behind head for deep long head stretch. Full extension at top. Keep elbows pointed forward, not flared.
Preacher: pad at armpit height, full extension at bottom, squeeze at top. Spider curl: chest on incline bench, arms hanging vertical — no momentum possible. Both emphasize the short head/peak.

ACTIVATION.
Full lat stretch at the bottom, drive the elbow straight back (not out). Squeeze at peak 1 sec. Get blood into the lats and mid-back. 
Last set to failure.

LOAD.
Barbell row, T-bar row, or Meadows row. Explosive pull, controlled eccentric. Controlled cheat on final set is ok. Leave 1 rep in tank.

PUMP.
PUMP: CLOSE NEUTRAL GRIP (palms facing each other, narrow). Elbows travel close to body, pull BEHIND you. This hits mid-traps, rhomboids, lower lats = THICKNESS muscles. 
Last set: drop set.

STRETCH.
Constant tension, lean forward. Emphasis on the DEEP STRETCH at the top of each rep (arms overhead, lats fully lengthened). Last set: partials in stretched position + 10-sec iso-hold at top.
Pinkies high, squeeze at peak.
Strict form, elbows pinned to sides. Slight wider-than-shoulder grip on EZ bar hits the short head. Full extension at bottom, squeeze at top. No body swing.
Neutral grip (palms facing each other). Hits the BRACHIALIS which sits under the bicep and pushes it up, creating arm thickness visible from the front. Also hits brachioradialis (forearm).
Set the bench to 45°. Arms hang straight down. Full stretch at the bottom, squeeze at the top.
